tech.summary: The New York Times aur Financial Times ki reports ke baad Nvidia ke board ne CEO Jensen Huang ke khilaf independent investigation ka elaan kar diya. Reports ke mutabiq Huang ka Singapore-based Megaspeed ki executive Alice Huang (Jensen se koi rishta nahi) se qareebi taluq tha, jise US intelligence ne China ki Ministry of State Security ki asset qarar diya hai. Huang ne staff ko bheje gaye memo mein affair tasleem karte hue maafi mangi. Board ka kehna hai ke national security ya company secrets compromise hone ka koi saboot nahi, lekin inquiry har pehlu dekhegi. US Congress ne Huang ko 18 November ko closed-door briefing ke liye bhi bula liya hai.
tech.title: Nvidia board ne Jensen Huang ki jaanch shuru kar di — Chinese spy se taluq ka ilzaam

tech.summary: France ki Mistral ne 29 October ko apne Mistral Large 4 ke weights Hugging Face par release kar diye — taqreeban 1 trillion total parameters, 49 billion active per token aur 1 million token context window ke saath. Company kehti hai ye coding aur cybersecurity mein behtareen open-weight model hai, lekin independent tests mein is ke headline numbers kam nikle: Terminal-Bench 4.0 par 25-26% jab ke Mistral ne 41% claim kiya tha. Model laptop par nahi chalega — official recipes 8-GPU servers mangte hain. License modified MIT hai, lekin model-as-a-service ke liye alag commercial license chahiye.
tech.title: Mistral ka 'Le Chonk' — 1 trillion parameters wala open-weight model ab sab ke liye

tech.summary: xAI ne 7 November se Grok API se aane wale text par invisible statistical watermark by default on kar diya hai. Ye saat models par laagu hai — grok-4.7 se le kar grok-4.20 ke teen variants tak — aur har API endpoint par chalega. Wajah EU AI Act ki transparency rules hain. Team admins per-model watermark band kar sakte hain, lekin unhein legal exception declare karni hogi aur faisla audit log mein record hoga. Watermark sirf API par hai — Grok app ya X par nahi — aur usay check karne ka detector sirf application par milta hai.
tech.title: Grok ke jawabon par ab invisible watermark — 7 November se by default

tech.summary: OpenAI ne 4 November ko Pierre Computer Company khareedne ka agreement kar liya — ek chhoti San Francisco startup jis ka Code Storage service aur Trees aur Diffs open-source libraries pehle se Codex ke andar use hoti hain. Deal ki price disclose nahi hui aur regulatory approval baqi hai. OpenAI ne isi hafte apna Git backend Pando bhi introduce kiya tha, kyun ke AI agents ke parallel kaam ne Git ki limits expose kar di thin. Code Storage customers service use karte rahenge jab tak us ke features Codex mein integrate nahi ho jate, aur Pierre ke open-source projects open hi rahenge.
tech.title: OpenAI ne Pierre khareed liya — Codex ke liye Git ki nayi neev

tech.summary: Anthropic ne 5 November ko Claude mein Personal Finance feature launch kar diya: US ke Pro, Max aur Ultra subscribers apne bank aur credit card accounts Plaid ke through link kar ke Claude se kharch, bills aur balances ke bare mein pooch sakte hain. Access sirf read-only hai — Claude paise move, pay ya invest nahi kar sakta — aur do saal tak ki transaction history parh sakta hai. Bank password Claude kabhi nahi dekhta, sign-in Plaid ki screen par hota hai. Feature beta mein hai, sirf US mein, aur is ki conversations AI training mein use nahi hongi.
tech.title: Claude ab aap ka bank statement parhega — Personal Finance beta US mein

tech.summary: OpenAI ne 4 November ko ChatGPT Images 2.6 launch kar diya — ab ChatGPT, Codex aur API mein animated GIFs ban sakte hain, aur images pehle se 50% tez generate hoti hain. API mein do naye models aaye hain: tez Flare (low quality par taqreeban 6 second mein image) aur detail-oriented Sunburst. Developers ko SVG export, image markup aur ek naya complexity control bhi mila hai. OpenAI ke mutabiq log ab ChatGPT par har hafte 4 billion images banate hain. Images 2.6 sab subscription tiers par globally available hai.
tech.title: ChatGPT Images 2.6 — ab GIFs banao, 50% tez

pakistan.summary: Wazir-e-Azam Shehbaz Sharif ne Jati Umra mein Nawaz Sharif ko Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ki security situation par brief kiya — Nawaz ne kaha ke emergency wali intervention pehle honi chahiye thi. KP set-up ne 'faceless' anti-terrorism courts ka elaan kiya hai taake judges, prosecutors aur witnesses ki pehchan chhupi rahe. Police aur CTD ke liye saalana Rs70bn ka package hai — Rs59.8bn police aur Rs10.3bn CTD ke liye. Home Secretary ke mutabiq pichle 2-3 saal mein 1,003 fauj, 627 police ahelkar aur 808 civilians shaheed hue, jab ke 3,788 terrorists mare gaye. Merged districts mein security ke liye budget ka sirf 3.2% mukhtas tha.
pakistan.title: KP security plan: Shehbaz ne Nawaz ko brief kiya — faceless ATCs aur Rs70bn ka elaan

pakistan.summary: World Bank ki Pakistan Poverty and Equity Brief (October 2026) ke mutabiq mulk mein ghurbat 21.9% (2018-19) se barh kar 28.9% (2024-25) ho gayi hai, aur 47.9% abadi $4.20 rozana wali international poverty line se neeche zindagi guzar rahi hai. Dehati areas mein masla aur gehra hai: combine harvesters aur self-propelled transplanters mazdooron ki jagah le rahe hain — ek Rs2.5m ki machine roz 10 acre transplant kar ke 60 se zyada mazdooron ka kaam kar deti hai. Industry itni jobs nahi bana rahi ke be-rozgar mazdooron ko absorb kar sake, jab ke 66% abadi 30 saal se kam umar ki hai.
pakistan.title: Pakistan mein ghurbat 28.9% tak — dehati mazdoor ki rozi par machine ka hamla

pakistan.summary: Senate Opposition Leader Allama Raja Nasir Abbas ne hukumat se mutalba kiya hai ke Pakistan Yemen ke tanaze se door rahe aur sirf mediatory role ada kare — un ke mutabiq 2015 ki parliament ki mutafaqa qarardad ki khilafwarzi mulki mufadat ko nuqsan pohanchayegi. Unhon ne bataya ke Yemen ne Pakistan ko mediation ki peshkash ki hai aur unhon ne is bare mein wazir-e-azam ko khat bhi likha hai. Abbas ne Yemen par hamon ki mazammat karte hue kaha ke Yemeni awam ko Gaza ki himayat ki saza di ja rahi hai, aur Imran Khan ko qomi masalihat mein role dene ki bhi baat ki.
pakistan.title: Senate opposition leader ka mutalba — Pakistan Yemen jang se door rahe

pakistan.summary: Karachi ke industrial areas mein rozana ka safar ab aik imtihan ban gaya hai — Korangi ka ek mazdoor public transport mein roz 4 ghante zaya karta hai, aur tooti sadkein, paani ki qillat aur kharab drainage industry ki cost barha rahe hain. Karachi wafaqi revenue ka taqreeban 67% aur exports ka 54% deta hai, lekin December 2025 mein manzoor Rs9bn ki road repairs ke 10 mahine baad bhi kaam shuru nahi hua. Korangi estate ke liye Rs2bn ki allocation bhi na-kaafi qarar di gayi. Mayor Murtaza Wahab ne agle saal allocation barhane ki yaqeen-dhani karayi hai.
pakistan.title: Karachi ki tooti sadkein — mazdoor 4 ghante safar mein, industry ko arabon ka nuqsan

pakistan.summary: Pakistan aur Sri Lanka ke darmiyan pehla Test aaj subah 9:30 baje Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium mein shuru ho raha hai — dusra Test 17 November se Lahore mein hoga. Babar Azam ki qayadat mein nayi team mein teen uncapped khiladi hain — Tayyab Arif, Ali Shabbir aur Saqib Khan — aur Aamir Jamal wapas aa gaye hain. Pakistan World Test Championship mein 9th number par hai (2 jeete, 7 haare), jab ke Sri Lanka ke naye Test captain Kusal Mendis apna pehla Test as captain khelenge. Dono Tests WTC 2025-27 ka hissa hain.
pakistan.title: Aaj se Rawalpindi Test — Babar ki nayi team, Sri Lanka ke khilaf redemption

pakistan.summary: Karachi Port ne July-October 2026 mein cargo throughput 3.8% barha kar 19.286 million tonnes kar liya — exports mein 10.5% izafa aur vessel calls mein 13.7% izafa hua. Port ne Container Port Performance Index mein 30 places ki chhalang laga kar 69th position hasil ki, aur MSC ne Karachi se Europe ke liye weekly Premium IPAK direct service shuru kar di. FY2025-26 mein port ne record 55.438m tonnes cargo handle kiya tha. KPT saalana Rs12bn wafaqi aur Rs5bn Sindh taxes deta hai, jab ke navigation channel ki dredging December 2026 tak mukammal hone ki tawaqqo hai.
pakistan.title: Karachi Port ki record daud — cargo 19.3m tonnes, duniya bhar ki shipping lines aa rahin
